excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a paleontologist, short black hair, tanned skin, wearing a green sun hat. Wears a light green blouse worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, green skirt and black hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Prying Sandstone Slabs on a Riverine Cliff Face

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_2, wearing her green sun hat, uses a steel pry bar to crack loose a heavy bedding layer of yellowish-gray sandstone on a steep river valley cliff face. The split stone reveals a massive, elongated cervical vertebra from a Mamenchisaurus. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
